llm.evidence: An LTQ-Orbitrap Velos mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, San Jose, CA, USA) interfaced with an UltiMate 3000 RSLCnano LC system (Thermo Scientific) was used for LC-MS/MS analysis.
The relative abundance of a taxon/function in a subject was calculated by summing the number of MS spectral counts matched to all ORFs assigned to that taxon/function
the mass spectrometer was set up in a data-dependent MS/MS mode
